svg.title: Example breadboard placement for JC4827W543 LED and button
svg.text: Numbered groups run vertically here: A–E joined; F–J joined; centre gap separates them.
GND rail (blue marking; connected to P4 GND)
Verify button contacts with a meter before insertion; rotate the switch if required.
Long LED leg = C15; short/flat side = C18. Rail breaks need a GND jumper. P4 3V3 stays unused.
